text:
Sam (CS): Quick heads-up 75  prepping a compact health readout for MeridiCo's QBR next Wed. Need slide owners, onboarding gap scrub, and renewal signals. Claim slides here.

Alyssa (CS): I9ll take onboarding status. Will list top 3 blockers + owners.

Maria (Eng): I9ll do metrics/latency slide  will pull last 30 days. @Alyssa want a one-line dev handoff note?

Sam (CS): Yes, 1 bullet only about recent infra change that impacted rollout.

Jon (Sales): I9ll own exec snapshot + renewal posture slide. Will include green/amber/red risk.

Kunal (RevOps): I9ll add ARR impact and timeline, plus proposed capacity/discount ask.

Alyssa (CS): Onboarding blockers draft: 1) SSO mapping mismatch 2) Missed training cadence 3) Integration test flakiness. Adding owners/dates now.

Sam (CS): For test flakiness, tag @Maria and OnboardBot for automation logs.

OnboardBot: reminder  MeridiCo onboarding run scheduled 2026-04-09 10:00 UTC. Logs: https://ci.example.com/runs/meridico-3412

Maria (Eng): Will include failing test snippet + one-line remediation in notes.

Alyssa (CS): Proposed slide order (one slide each):
1) Exec snapshot (Jon)
2) Health metrics & trends (Maria)
3) Onboarding status & blockers (Alyssa)
4) Renewal posture & asks (Jon / Kunal)
5) Action register & owners (Sam)

Sam (CS): Drop slides in this deck by EOD Tue: https://drive.example.com/meridico-qbr-deck. Comment if no access.

Jon (Sales): Any Product dependency to call out?

Alyssa (CS): Yes  need a short self-triage runbook from Product. No ETA yet. Put as dependency on action slide.

Maria (Eng): If Product can't deliver before QBR, call that out; it affects the remediation timeline.

Kunal (RevOps): I9ll model baseline vs contingency renewals; contingency increases discount sensitivity if runbook missing.

Sam (CS): Action row template I9m using:
- Action: <short desc>
- Owner: <name>
- Due: <YYYY-MM-DD>
- Impact: <onboarding|renewal|ops>
- Status: <todo/in-progress/done>

Alyssa (CS): First action added: SSO mapping fix  Owner: Maria (Eng)  Due: 2026-04-07  Impact: onboarding  Status: in-progress.

Maria (Eng): Confirmed. I9ll attach the failing trace in deck notes.

Jon (Sales): If Kunal's contingency goes red I9ll escalate with the customer sponsor Tue afternoon.

Sam (CS): Pull two short customer feedback quotes for the health slide. Alyssa can you grab NPS snippets?

Alyssa (CS): On it  will add up to 2 bullets from last 2 weeks.

OnboardBot: action created  "MeridiCo onboarding logs pull" assigned to Alyssa (CS) due 2026-04-06.

Sam (CS): Slide guidance: max 3 bullets per slide. Execs want clear risk + asks only.

Maria (Eng): Will keep to 3 bullets + one-line tech appendix in notes.

Kunal (RevOps): Adding a backup sensitivity slide for discount ask.

Sam (CS): Running a 20-min dry-run Tue 17:00 UTC. If you can't make it, send your slide beforehand.

Jon (Sales): I9ll attend.

Alyssa (CS): Might be 5 min late, will upload early.

Maria (Eng): Sending slide by EOD Tue.

Sam (CS): Thanks all. I9ll compile the deck and action register after EOD Tue and post here. Update this thread if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
